description:
Make a timeless statement with the French Country Crib featuring a panel-style front. The solid raised panel headboard adds warmth and architectural depth, creating a cozy, inviting focal point for your baby's room.

This 4-in-1 convertible crib is handcrafted from solid wood with the same attention to detail that defines the entire French Country collection. Transition seamlessly from crib to toddler bed, daybed, and full-size (double) bed as your child grows, making this a single investment that serves your family for years. Three adjustable mattress height settings provide flexibility and safety from newborn to toddler.

Finished with non-toxic, baby-safe materials and rigorously tested to exceed CPSC and ASTM standards.

If you would like help choosing a finish, confirming timing, or picturing how this piece fits your nursery plans, use Get Personal Assistance. We reply the same or next business day so you can decide with full information, at your own pace.
